title: Nodal curves are etale local on the source
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\{h_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a jointly surjective family (every point of $X$ is the image of a point of some $U_i$) of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Call a morphism nodal of relative dimension one if it is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], every nonempty geometric fibre [def-weil-geometric-fibre] is purely one-dimensional [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and every nonsmooth point [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of a geometric fibre over an algebraically closed field $\Omega$ has completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Then $f$ is nodal of relative dimension one if and only if every $f\circ h_i$ is nodal of relative dimension one. There are no quasi-compactness, separatedness or Noetherian assumptions; the family may be empty when $X$ is empty.
